reviews.comment: Dr Ross is soo sweet! She is very passionate about what she is talking about and has a lot of interesting knowledge to go along with it. Main thing is you will get points taken off for missing class, but the actual work you do is very very easy.

I took ENGL 394 but its not letting me say that. The class was fun, she's really nice. There's 2 big projects, one at midterms and one as our final. Both we're not that hard. The only homework is case notes for the books you read for class. We read 6 books and you actually have to read them bc it's pretty niche stuff. I would def take her again.

Such a sweet lady! She was extremely understanding, not one of the profs that doesn't care if you live or die. She extended due dates on multiple assignments. Class really was not bad, multiple books were assigned but I didn't really read them and still got an A. Highly recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Ross's class is pretty easy. She assigned 3 books and I only read the last one. The discussion posts are harder I think than the essays and my grade showed that. If you read all the books then it will be such an easy A but if you decide not to read them then Google will be your best friend and you can still make a good grade take it from me

Dr. Ross is a wonderful English professor. I am not an English major, but she made me enjoy the course a lot more than I thought I would. She's a very sweet lady, and her enthusiasm for the novels she assigned made them more interesting. This class is great for an upper-level English or the "cultural discourse" credit.
